suppress.notes: False Positive: CVE-2026-2586 and CVE-2026-2587 affect GlassFish application server and administrative console components. The scanned artifact is JAXB Core (XML binding library) and was erroneously matched to the eclipse:glassfish application server CPE.

False Positive: CVE-2026-2586 and CVE-2026-2587 affect GlassFish application server and administrative console components. The scanned artifact is TXW2 (XML writing library) and was erroneously matched to the eclipse:glassfish application server CPE.
False Positive: This Maven artifact is Flyway's PostgreSQL database migration adapter version 12.4.0, which was erroneously mapped to PostgreSQL Server 12.4.0 CPE.
False Positive: CVE-2026-53914 concerns unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build-cache metadata. The runtime kotlin-stdlib artifact does not implement the affected build-cache compiler functionality.
False Positive: CVE-2026-39883 applies to opentelemetry-go and its BSD/Solaris host-ID implementation. This artifact is the Java semantic-conventions library.
False Positive: CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server remote-read /api/v1/read endpoint, not Micrometer's Java registry client library.

These CVEs affect Eclipse GlassFish application-server Admin Console functionality. The scanned Maven artifact is JAXB Runtime and does not contain the affected GlassFish Admin Console functionality. Dependency-Check has incorrectly associated the artifact with the eclipse:glassfish product CPE.

Prometheus client_java 1.7.0 modules are being incorrectly mapped to the Prometheus server 1.7.0 CPE.
These io.prometheus:prometheus-metrics-* artifacts belong to the Java client_java project and do not implement the Prometheus server or its /api/v1/read remote-read endpoint.
Therefore the Prometheus server CPE is not applicable to these Java client modules.
This rule suppresses ONLY that incorrect server CPE and only for io.prometheus:prometheus-metrics-* artifacts at version 1.7.0. Vulnerabilities associated through any other CPE or identifier remain visible.

False Positive: This Maven artifact is a Testcontainers Java module for launching PostgreSQL containers in testing and simulation environments. It was incorrectly mapped by Dependency-Check to PostgreSQL Server version 2.0.5 CPE.

docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 shades Apache HttpClient 5.5.1. CVE-2026-71290 affects the ASYNC HttpClient implementation. The Apache advisory explicitly states that the CLASSIC HttpClient implementation is not affected. docker-java zerodep uses the classic HttpClient transport path. Therefore the vulnerable async execution path is not used by this component in LedgerGuard/Testcontainers. This is a NOT-AFFECTED / usage-context classification.
